data.one_liner: Plugin to open app stores, editor reviews, and install APK files on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to open app store pages and reviews, as well as install APK files on supported platforms. Supports Android, iOS, and macOS.
use_when: You need to direct users to your app store page from inside the app.
You need to install local APK files programmatically on Android.
avoid_when: You are not targeting mobile platforms or macOS.
You do not require APK installation capabilities.
strengths: Supports opening app store pages and app reviews.
Enables APK installation on Android devices.
weaknesses: Requires proper storage permissions on Android to avoid parsing errors.
App store reviews are not available on Android.
data.setup_notes: You need to allow read storage permissions first on Android to properly install APK files without parsing errors.
